sad.text: The saddest people always smile the brightest. You never know what they're going through.
Pain changes people. It makes them trust less, overthink more, and shut down slowly.
Some wounds take longer to heal, and some never heal at all.
The worst feeling isn't being alone. It's being forgotten by someone you'd never forget.
Silence is the best answer to someone who doesn't value your words.
Missing someone is your heart's way of reminding you that you care.
Tears are words that the heart can't express.
The hardest thing about pain is that you never know when it'll hit you, and when it does, it hits hard.
Some people are like clouds. When they disappear, it's a beautiful day.
Grief is the price we pay for love.
The wound is the place where the light enters you.
Ever has it been known that love knows not its own depth until the hour of separation.
Behind every beautiful thing, there's been some kind of pain.
Nothing can cure the soul but the senses, just as nothing can cure the senses but the soul.
To live is to suffer, to survive is to find some meaning in the suffering.
Out of suffering have emerged the strongest souls.
The deeper that sorrow carves into your being, the more joy you can contain.
What we once enjoyed and deeply loved we can never lose, for all that we love deeply becomes a part of us.
It is better to have loved and lost than never to have loved at all.
Sometimes the hardest part isn't letting go but rather learning to start over.
The goodbye they give is never the one you expect.
Everyone you love is going to die, and you don't know when.
The only way to get rid of a temptation is to yield to it.
In the depth of winter, I finally learned that within me there lay an invincible summer.
The heart was made to be broken.
I keep myself busy with the things I do, but every time I pause, I still think of you.
Crying is the only way your eyes speak when your mouth can't explain how broken your heart is.
You can't rush something that you want to last forever.
The worst kind of sad is not being able to explain why.
It hurts when you realize you aren't as important to someone as you thought you were.
Some days are just bad days, and that's okay. You don't have to pretend everything is fine.
The hardest part about being strong is that no one ever asks if you're okay.
I'm not okay, and that's okay. I'm healing at my own pace.
Sometimes you have to smile to hide your tears, laugh to hide the pain, and pretend everything is fine.
Sadness flies away on the wings of time.
The greatest pain comes from leaving someone you still love.
You don't know what you have until you lose it, and you don't know what you've been missing until it arrives.
I wish I could turn back the clock. I'd find you sooner and love you longer.
The worst feeling in the world is when you can't love anyone else because your heart still belongs to someone who left.
I pretend that I'm fine, but maybe I'm not. And that's okay too.
Sadness is always the background music of my life.
A broken heart is just the growing pains you need so you can love more completely when the real thing comes.
The moment you feel like giving up is the moment you need to keep pushing.
You never know how strong you are until being strong is the only choice you have.
One of the hardest things in life is having words in your heart that you can't utter.
I wish I could give you my pain just for a moment so you could understand what I go through every day.
Sometimes the person who tries to keep everyone happy is always the most lonely.
Loneliness is not lack of company, it is lack of purpose.
The strongest people are not those who show strength in front of you but those who win battles you know nothing about.
You don't heal in days, you heal in moments. The moments where you choose to let go and move forward.

love.text: Love isn't about how many days, months, or years you've been together. Love is about how much you love each other every single day.
In a world of billions, I found my one. That's the miracle of love.
The best thing to hold onto in life is each other.
I fell in love the way you fall asleep: slowly, and then all at once.
You are my heart, my life, my one and only thought.
The greatest happiness of life is the conviction that we are loved.
Love is not finding someone to live with. It's finding someone you can't live without.
Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast.
I love you without knowing how, or when, or from where.
Whatever our souls are made of, yours and mine are the same.
You know you're in love when you can't fall asleep because reality is finally better than your dreams.
The best love is the kind that awakens the soul and makes us reach for more.
You are my sun, my moon, and all my stars.
In all the world, there is no heart for me like yours.
I would rather share one lifetime with you than face all the ages of this world alone.
My heart is, and always will be, yours.
Love does not consist of gazing at each other, but in looking outward together in the same direction.
If I know what love is, it is because of you.
Your voice is my favorite sound.
Every love story is beautiful, but ours is my favorite.
You are my today and all of my tomorrows.
I love you more than yesterday, less than tomorrow.
You make me want to be a better person.
I have waited for this opportunity to tell you how much you mean to me.
I am who I am because of you.
The very essence of romance is uncertainty.
Love is an irresistible desire to be irresistibly desired.
We are most alive when we're in love.
Love is the bridge between two hearts.
In dreams and in love there are no impossibilities.
Where there is love there is life.
The only thing we never get enough of is love.
I fell in love with your smile, your laugh, and the way you make me feel alive.
To love and be loved is to feel the sun from both sides.
The greatest thing you'll ever learn is just to love and be loved in return.
I loved her, and sometimes she loved me too.
When you look at me, what do you see? Because when I look at you, I see my whole world.
You came into my life and suddenly I had a reason to smile.
I don't need paradise because I found you. I don't need dreams because I already have you.
I wish I could explain your eyes, how the sound of your voice gives me butterflies.
When I'm with you, I feel safe from all the storms of life.
Your love is the only air I need to breathe.
I didn't choose you. My heart did. And it chose perfectly.
You're the reason I look at my phone and smile.
My favorite place in the world is next to you.
I want to grow old with you. We'll count our wrinkles and laugh about the things that used to bother us.
You're not just my love, you're my best friend, my soulmate, and my everything.
The day I met you, my life began. Every day after that has been a gift.
I love the way you make me feel like I'm the only person in the world.

motivation.text: The only impossible journey is the one you never begin.
Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
Believe you can and you're halfway there.
Hard times don't create heroes. It is during the hard times when the hero within us is revealed.
Don't watch the clock; do what it does. Keep going.
It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
Your time is limited, don't waste it living someone else's life.
Dream big, start small, act now.
The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
In the middle of every difficulty lies opportunity.
Don't be afraid to give up the good to go for the great.
The only limit to our realization of tomorrow is our doubts of today.
Act as if what you do makes a difference. It does.
What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.
The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.
Everything you've ever wanted is on the other side of fear.
Don't be pushed around by the fears in your mind. Be led by the dreams in your heart.
Success is walking from failure to failure with no loss of enthusiasm.
It is during our darkest moments that we must focus to see the light.
You are never too old to set another goal or to dream a new dream.
All our dreams can come true if we have the courage to pursue them.
The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
If you're going through hell, keep going.
I have not failed. I've just found 10,000 ways that won't work.
Opportunities don't happen. You create them.
Some people dream of success, while others get up every morning and make it happen.
The only thing standing between you and your goal is the story you keep telling yourself.
Don't stop when you're tired. Stop when you're done.
Wake up with determination. Go to bed with satisfaction.
Do something today that your future self will thank you for.
Little things make big days.
It's going to be hard, but hard does not mean impossible.
You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
The struggle you're in today is developing the strength you need for tomorrow.
Don't wait for opportunity. Create it.
Sometimes we're tested not to show our weaknesses, but to discover our strengths.
The key to success is to focus on goals, not obstacles.
Dream it. Wish it. Do it.
Success doesn't just find you. You have to go out and get it.
The harder you work for something, the greater you'll feel when you achieve it.
Don't stop when it hurts. Stop when you're done.
What you get by achieving your goals is not as important as what you become by achieving your goals.
A year from now you may wish you had started today.
The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
Action is the foundational key to all success.
Don't watch the clock; do what it does. Keep going.
Your limitation—it's only your imagination.
Push yourself, because no one else is going to do it for you.
Great things never come from comfort zones.

shayari.text:
Tere bina zindagi adhoori si lagti hai,
Jaise kisi kitaab ka aakhri panna chhoot gaya ho.
Teri yaadon mein khoya phirta hoon,
Dil ki dhadkan mein bas tera naam goonjta hai.

Mohabbat ki hai tujhse, na koi shikwa hai na koi shikayat,
Bas tu mere paas ho yeh dua hai.
Teri aankhon mein jo duniya hai,
Woh kisi aur mein nahi, sirf tujh mein hai.

Dil mein teri yaadon ka ek mela sa lagta hai,
Kabhi hansi kabhi aansu yeh dil dhalta hai.
Teri yaadon ka sahara hai,
Teri tasveer se dil ka karara hai.

Tere aane se zindagi mein rang aate hain,
Tere jaane se sab rang fade ho jaate hain.
Teri aawaz sunke dil ko sukoon milta hai,
Teri yaadon se raat guzar jaati hai.

Woh baat karte hain hamse,
Toh lagta hai jaise duniya ki sabse badi nemat mil gayi.
Unki har baat mein pyar hai,
Unki har nigah mein jannat hai.

Ishq mein humne kya khoya, kya paaya,
Bas itna jaana ki tere bina kuch nahi.
Tere bina zindagi ek safar hai bina manzil ke,
Tere saath har pal ek kahani hai.

Teri yaadon ka ek hi sahara hai,
Teri tasveer se dil ka karara hai.

Kuch toh majbooriyan rahi hongi,
Yun koi bewafa nahi hota.
Dil toota toh kya hua,
Zindagi toh chalti rahegi.

Zindagi mein kuch iss tarah ghul gaye tum,
Jaise paani mein rang ghul jaate hain.

Jaise kisi kitaab ka aakhri panna chhoot gaya ho.

Hum toh fakir aadmi hain,
Mahal ki baatein kaise karein.
Bas tere pyar mein ye dil lutaye baithe hain,
Tere intezaar mein ye raat kaali ho gayi.

Teri ek jhalak ke liye tarse ye aankhen,
Teri ek smile ke liye tarse ye dil.
Dil ki har dhadkan mein tera naam hai,
Tere bina ye zindagi adhoori hai.

Kuch alfaaz hain jo dil se nikalte hain,
Kuch yaadein hain jo aankhon se bahe jaati hain.
Dil ka sukoon teri yaadon mein hai,
Teri tasveer se mera jahan hai.

Tere bichadne ke baad,
Humne shayariyon mein apna dard dhoondha.
Na pooch mere dil ka haal,
Teri yaadon mein ye roz bikhar jaata hai.

Na pooch mere dil ka haal,
Teri yaadon mein ye roz bikhar jaata hai.
Dil ki har dhadkan mein bas tera naam hai,
Tere bina ye dil akela hai.

Tere pyar ka asar hai ke ab humari har ghazal mein tera hi zikr hai,
Woh raatein jo tere saath guzari thi, ab yaadon mein bhi meethi lagti hain.
Tere bina bhi zindagi chalti hai, par har pal adhoora sa lagta hai,
Main kya likhun tere baare mein, jab har alfaaz tere naam se shuru hota hai.

I carry your heart with me. I carry it in my heart.
I am never without it.
Anywhere I go you go, my dear.
And whatever is done by only me is your doing, my darling.

How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.
I love thee to the depth and breadth and height
My soul can reach, when feeling out of sight
For the ends of being and ideal grace.

Love is composed of a single soul inhabiting two bodies.
When we are together, nothing else matters.
You are my heart's desire, my soul's companion.
Together we are complete, forever and always.

The soul that sees beauty may sometimes walk alone.
But when two souls find each other, the world becomes beautiful.
You found me when I was lost, and now I'm found.
Your love is my compass, my guide, my home.

We are most alive when we're in love.
You make my heart sing, my soul dance.
With you by my side, every moment is magic.
I am yours, completely and forever.

Love is an irresistible desire to be irresistibly desired.
Your smile lights up my darkest days.
Your touch heals my deepest wounds.
You are my everything, my reason for living.

The greatest thing you'll ever learn is just to love and be loved in return.
You taught me what love really means.
It's not about possession, it's about connection.
And with you, my soul is connected to yours.

To love and be loved is to feel the sun from both sides.
Your love warms my heart like morning sun.
It gives me strength to face each day.
You are my sunshine, my everything.

The emotion that comes from deep connection is love.
When I'm with you, time stops.
The world fades away, and it's just us.
You are my peace, my calm, my sanctuary.

Love is the bridge between two hearts.
You built that bridge with your kindness.
And now my heart crosses to yours every day.
I am forever grateful for your love.

In dreams and in love there are no impossibilities.
With you, I dream bigger, love harder.
You make me believe in forever.
You are my dream come true.

Where there is love there is life.
You brought life to my existence.
You filled my world with color and joy.
I am alive because of your love.

The only thing we never get enough of is love.
I crave your presence, your touch, your smile.
Every moment with you is a treasure.
I want a lifetime of us.

I fell in love with your smile, your laugh, and the way you make me feel alive.
You are the reason my heart beats.
You are the reason I believe in love.
You are my everything.

Every love story is beautiful, but ours is my favorite.
We've had our ups and downs, our highs and lows.
But through it all, our love only grew stronger.
You are my forever and always.

You are my today and all of my tomorrows.
I choose you today, tomorrow, and every day after.
My love for you grows with each passing moment.
You are my partner, my best friend, my soulmate.

I love you more than yesterday, less than tomorrow.
My love for you is infinite, boundless, endless.
You are the missing piece I never knew I needed.
Now that I have you, I am complete.

You make me want to be a better person.
Your love inspires me to reach for the stars.
With you, I am the best version of myself.
Thank you for loving me the way you do.

My heart is, and always will be, yours.
I gave it to you the moment I fell in love.
And I don't want it back.
It belongs with you, forever.
